import pyautogui, time

# Focus the editor by clicking inside the code area
pyautogui.click(300, 200)
time.sleep(0.5)

# Go to line 2
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'g')
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.typewrite('2')
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(0.2)

# Select lines 2–10 (9 lines total) using Ctrl+L
for _ in range(9):
    pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'l')
    time.sleep(0.1)

# Indent the selection by one tab
pyautogui.press('tab')
